name: Databricks
summary: Run queries on a Databricks SQL warehouse and load Parquet partitions with COPY INTO. Loads are idempotent by partition and revision (ADR 0012).

fields.name: personal_access_token
fields.label: Personal access token
fields.help: Create it in the workspace under user settings; store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: workspace_host
settings.label: Workspace host
settings.help: The host of the workspace URL, without https://.

operators.summary: Run a SQL statement on a SQL warehouse and keep the result as Parquet.
Load staged Parquet into a table with COPY INTO, once per partition and revision.

notes: COPY INTO reads from cloud object storage the workspace can already access; add that store's connector domains to the same egress approval. Ogun does not create the table or the storage credential.
